name: sound
description: Code taste as installable rules, and the current best tool for a need. Probe a repo's stack, select only the rules its code shows a surface for (evidence-cited per rule), confirm, and scaffold a browsable .claude/sound/ rule map (surfaced by the sound:prime skill). Installed rules are user-owned; re-runs reconcile. sound:find names tools an agent can run end to end, from sources fetched live; sound:stack writes them into CLAUDE.md for a project's hand steps.
